players.name: Giancarlo Stanton
players.summary: Placed on 10-day IL April 28 with a low-grade right calf strain tweaked while running bases April 25. MRI confirmed minor strain; eligible to return ~May 8.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Rough start vs. Oakland (5 IP, 5 H, 4 ER, 2 BB, 5 K). KC lost 6-3 and Ragans took the loss. ERA climbs to 5.34 through 6 starts.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Pitched a clean 9th inning vs. Washington (1 K, 0 ER) but had no save opportunity as the Mets lost 5-4. ERA remains elevated at 8.60 through 7.1 IP on the season.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: PHI swept SFG in a doubleheader. Harper walked twice (bases-loaded walk G1, IBB G2), going 1-for-5 with 1 R and 1 RBI across both games.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: 2-for-7 across the April 30 doubleheader at PHI. Delivered a 2-run single in the 9th of Game 2. Season average climbs to .313.

players.name: Kevin McGonigle
players.summary: 0-for-3 as Tigers beat Atlanta 5-2. Batting .178 (16-for-90) to start his MLB career.

injuries.name: Giancarlo Stanton
injuries.note: Low-grade right calf strain tweaked while running bases April 25. MRI confirmed minor strain. Eligible to return ~May 8.
